# Commands -- every tool, its CLI and its page equivalent

*Generated by `scripts/agent_commands.py` from the tool schema in
`core/agent/tools.py` (contracts §7). Do not edit by hand; run the
script. The agent (`python -m flightsim.agent`), the CLIs and the
web app are three doors onto the same library; a screen's command
is the one named here.*

    python -m flightsim.agent "<prompt>" --images N --out DIR [--format F] [--vary WORDS]

Every tool call is checked by the authority policy (`authority.stated_field`,
`authority.validation_token`, `authority.refusal_is_not_a_run`,
`authority.budget`) and written to `DIR/trace.jsonl` as
`{t, tool, input, output, reason, policy}`.

## `compile`

Turn a prompt (plus an answer round) into a spec with provenance, the clarifying questions it needs, and the refusals it carries. Runs nothing; the spec's provenance becomes the reference every later spec input is compared with.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes |  |
| `answers` | array or null | no | null |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.campaign "<prompt>" --images N --out DIR --plan`
* **UI:** POST /compile; the generate page's ask and clarify states

## `validate`

Validate a spec exactly as it is and, when it carries no refusal, mint the validation_token that run, render and export require for this digest. A refused spec gets no token.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spec` | object | yes |  |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.campaign "<prompt>" --images N --out DIR --plan  (the plan validates)`
* **UI:** the validation verdict under the spec table (POST /compile)

## `plan_campaign`

Plan a campaign from a spec: the policy words (the prompt vocabulary, e.g. 'varied weather at different times of day') or an explicit policy are applied as a RECORDED plan edit to a spec that states no policy of its own, the campaign directory is created and its plan (frames per case, cases needed, disk) is estimated. Refuses by name before anything runs.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spec` | object | yes |  |
| `words` | string | no | "" |
| `images` | integer | no | 100 |
| `seed` | integer or null | no | null |
| `format` | string | no | "coco" |
| `policy` | object or null | no | null |
| `render` | boolean | no | false |
| `out` | string or null | no | null |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.campaign "<prompt>" --images N --out DIR --plan`
* **UI:** POST /generate/plan; the preview state

## `sample`

Draw the next n slots by index (or n from start): the cases with their sampled leaves, and the refused slots by name. A refused slot is a ledger row; the sampler draws only system-chosen leaves -- a stated value is never re-drawn.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `campaign_id` | string | yes |  |
| `n` | integer | no | 1 |
| `start` | integer or null | no | null |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.campaign "<prompt>" --images N --out DIR --sample N`
* **UI:** POST /generate/preview

## `run`

Run one case (a case id from sample: the slot is captured through the campaign's own worker function and ledgered as the campaign ledgers it) or a whole campaign (a campaign id: it runs to its target or a named end, the only way done is written). Needs the validation_token minted for the campaign's spec.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `case_id` | string | yes |  |
| `validation_token` | string | yes |  |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.campaign --out DIR --resume  (a campaign); python -m flightsim.capture runs/<case>/spec.yaml --out runs/<case>  (one case)`
* **UI:** POST /generate/start; POST /run for one case

## `render`

The frames a run recorded and whether pixels exist for them. Pixels are drawn inside run() by the capture CLI when the campaign was planned with render=True and an engine is present; this tool reports, it does not launch an engine.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | string | yes |  |
| `validation_token` | string | yes |  |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.capture spec.yaml --out DIR --render`
* **UI:** the frames gallery (GET /generate/{id}/frames)

## `verify`

Re-run the verifier over a run directory, read-only: every check with its status and the verdict (pass / fail / not_run -- NOT RUN is not a pass). verification.json is not written here.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | string | yes |  |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.verify runs/<case>`
* **UI:** GET /runs/{id}/verification.json; the review state

## `export`

Export every verified case of a campaign in a format the export module lists (coco, kitti, webdataset, yolo, voc) into <campaign>/datasets/<format>, with the dataset card.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `campaign_id` | string | yes |  |
| `format` | string | yes |  |
| `validation_token` | string | yes |  |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.export runs/* --out DIR --format FORMAT; python -m flightsim.campaign --out DIR --resume --export`
* **UI:** GET /generate/{id}/download?format=

## `inspect`

The per-frame records of a run (one frame, or all) and an overlay PNG drawn on the rendered frame where pixels exist.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | string | yes |  |
| `frame` | integer or null | no | null |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.verify runs/<case> --render  (overlays)`
* **UI:** the overlays under the frames page

## `report`

Write and return the campaign's report.json: yield against the target, coverage of the requested policy bins, refusals by name (slots and attempts), timing and disk -- every number from the ledger and the manifests.

| parameter | type | required | default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `campaign_id` | string | yes |  |

* **CLI:** `python -m flightsim.campaign --out DIR --report`
* **UI:** GET /generate/{id}; the review state
